latestVersion.changelog:
Exam Study Guide & Predictor v0.1.0

- Initial release: transforms students’ provided materials into a study guide and predicts likely exam questions, tailored to biology family courses and related sciences.
- Requires a step-by-step intake interview to identify exam type, format, marks distribution, materials, and deliverable details before building the guide.
- Uses direct professor statements, past exams, and model answers as strongest signals for prediction; all predictions are confidence-ranked and evidence-justified.
- Processes and integrates English and Arabic (or code-switched) professor transcripts, flagging direct exam advice separately from inferred predictions.
- Adapts to the specific nature of the exam (e.g., lab/practical, image-based), activating only the relevant workflows and sections. 
- Optionally exports predicted Q/A pairs for Anki flashcard use.

Apply when code is hard to maintain, a function/type has grown too large, a code smell needs fixing, adding a feature is blocked by the current structure, or the user asks to clean up, refactor, or improve Go code — also for renaming at scale, extracting functions/interfaces, moving code between packages, splitting packages, or planning a multi-step refactor. Target styles owned elsewhere → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-naming` (renames), `@golang-project-layout` (splits), `@golang-modernize` (idioms), `@golang-code-style` (control flow), `@golang-design-patterns` (patterns/DI).
